name: Primary care physicians
plain: How many primary care physicians are registered with a practice address in each municipio.
definition: Primary care physicians registered in NPPES with a practice location in the municipio (taxonomy codes 207Q, 208D, 207R00000X, 208000000X, 207V00000X). Counted at the primary practice location in the NPPES registry, by the provider's primary taxonomy code. A registry, not a head count: a provider who left, retired or works part-time may still be listed. To protect individuals, a municipio with 1 to 9 is shown empty; the island total is exact.

coverage.frequency: Monthly file; rebuilt by hand with python providers.py --refresh.

method: providers.py streams the NPPES monthly full file, keeps individual providers (entity type 1) with an active NPI and a Puerto Rico practice location, and counts them by their primary taxonomy code in the municipio of the practice location: the city when it is a municipio's name, else a known postal place, else the municipio holding most of the land of the ZIP code (the placement nonprofits.py uses; 99.9% placed). A municipio with 1 to 9 is not published.
source_detail: CMS NPPES monthly full file (NPPES_November_2026_V2.zip): individual providers with an active NPI and a Puerto Rico practice location, by primary taxonomy, counted by municipio
how_to_read: Puerto Rico: 7,296 registered; 3,302 of them updated their record in the last five years. The number practising is likely between the two. Most: San Juan (1,606), Bayamón (545), Ponce (523).
caveats: A registry, not a head count: a provider who left Puerto Rico, retired or works part-time may still be listed; one person who practises in several municipios is counted once.
To protect individuals, a municipio with 1 to 9 is shown empty; 0 and 10 or more are shown, and the island total is exact.
14,018 of the 25,740 records counted were last updated more than five years ago.
